basis.governing_question: Why did Vinhos do Douro Lda's export margins fall in 2025?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why export margins fell in 2025 by examining pricing in each export market and distributor terms.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on why export margins fell?

architect_notes: Engagement type is assumed from 'a quick diagnostic'; confirm assessment-only before quoting, because an implementation scope would add phases to the plan.
Departure from the performance_improvement archetype: Implementation dropped because the type is assessment, so one Diagnostic phase covers the stated eight weeks.
